decisions.reason: The gold-medal premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship and clearly exceeds aspirations, so there is no reason to search for other uses of its resources.

The firm has already pruned three of its four new breads, which leaves the dark malt rye as a remaining niche variant at some risk, but it survived that review and runs on the existing rye line at low cost, so it is kept.
The marzipan stollen rounds out the award-winning seasonal stollen and gift assortment, and it costs little to keep alongside the flagship.
